name: veritas-peps-v1
description: Retrieval questions over 10 public-domain Python PEPs. A retrieved chunk is relevant when it comes from `doc` and contains `evidence` (whitespace-normalised, case-insensitive). `style` is 'lexical' when the question reuses the source's wording and 'paraphrase' when it deliberately does not. Questions with doc=null are not answerable from the corpus and are used to calibrate abstention.

questions.question: What is the maximum line length PEP 8 recommends for code?
questions.evidence: Limit all lines to a maximum of 79 characters

questions.question: How wide should comments and docstrings be wrapped, as opposed to code?
How many spaces per indentation level does the style guide use?
Should I indent with tabs or with spaces?
questions.evidence: Spaces are the preferred indentation method

questions.question: How much vertical whitespace goes between top-level functions and classes?
questions.evidence: Surround top-level function and class definitions with two blank lines

questions.question: In what order should groups of imports be listed?
Which single letters are bad variable names because they look like the digits one and zero?
How should comparisons to None be written?
questions.evidence: Comparisons to singletons like None should always be done with

questions.question: What should I use instead of slicing a string to check its prefix?
How are constants named and where are they defined?
questions.evidence: Constants are usually defined on a module level

questions.question: Which source file encoding should code in the core distribution use?
Why is catching every exception without naming a type discouraged?
What does the Zen of Python say about failures being ignored quietly?
How many obvious ways should there be to do something?
questions.evidence: preferably only one --obvious way to do it

questions.question: What does the Zen of Python call one honking great idea?
questions.evidence: Namespaces are one honking great idea

questions.question: Which quote style should docstrings use?
Should a one-line docstring be written as a command ending with a full stop?
questions.evidence: The docstring is a phrase ending in a period

questions.question: How is a longer docstring structured after its first line?
questions.evidence: followed by a blank line, followed by a more elaborate

questions.question: Is there a blank line before or after a one-line docstring?
questions.evidence: There's no blank line either before or after the docstring

questions.question: Which file marks a directory as a lightweight virtual environment?
How can a virtual environment also see the globally installed packages?
Which sys attribute points at the base installation's prefix inside a venv?
Can escape characters be used inside the braces of an f-string?
questions.evidence: Backslashes may not appear inside the expression portions

questions.question: Which conversion flags like !r are allowed in f-strings?
Are formatted string literals constant values or computed when the program runs?
What existing string formatting mechanisms motivated adding a new one?
Why was TOML picked over JSON for the build configuration file?
What was wrong with setuptools' setup_requires argument?
Where can individual tools such as linters keep their own settings in pyproject.toml?
What is the syntax of the walrus operator for assigning inside an expression?
Are unparenthesized assignment expressions allowed at the top level of an expression statement?
questions.evidence: Unparenthesized assignment expressions are prohibited at the top level of an expression statement

questions.question: Show an example of reading a file in fixed-size pieces in a loop condition.
How can a comprehension reuse a computed value in both its filter and its output?
questions.evidence: Share a subexpression between a comprehension filter clause and its output

questions.question: Which field gives the name of the project in the [project] table?
Why must metadata that a build backend fills in later be declared explicitly?
questions.evidence: the distinction between static and dynamic metadata

questions.question: How do I declare which Python versions a project supports?
Which pattern matches anything as a catch-all case in a match statement?
What is a guard in a match case?
questions.evidence: Guards consist of the ``if`` keyword followed by any expression

questions.question: How can one case accept several alternative patterns?
questions.evidence: symbol in patterns combines them as alternatives

questions.question: Where are a function's annotations stored at runtime?
Do lambdas support annotations?
How do I disable the global interpreter lock at runtime?
How do I configure Django's database connection pooling?
What is the default timeout of asyncio.wait_for?
What is the company refund policy for annual subscriptions?
How does NumPy broadcasting align array shapes?
Will it rain in Addis Ababa tomorrow?
